implementation_freeze_contract.description: Implementation freeze identity is defined non-self-referentially as the Git commit containing this preregistration (Commit A). The runtime execution runner captures `git rev-parse HEAD` dynamically before formal cell #1, verifies a clean worktree, and records that exact Commit A SHA in the first persisted STARTED journal and raw results authority.

d4_a1_authority.findings: A1 proved on the two frozen target dependencies that legacy locator present retains evidence, suppression loses evidence, and generic structured replacement restores evidence with governed witness (event_poca_handoff and restgas_profile_workflow REPLACEMENT_VALIDATED, REGRESSION_REPLACEMENT = 0).

d3_cohort_authority.selection_principle: Reuses unchanged historical D3-A0-R1 / D3-A2 comparison cohort frozen before D4-A1 outcome exposure; outcome-independent T2 regression surface.

BEFORE_COMPAT.description: Current compatibility reference behavior: production configs/query_expansions.yaml active with all Batch-1 fixed locators active, generic D3.5 structured replacement OFF, reserved admission OFF.

AFTER_BATCH1_REPLACEMENT.description: Proposed Batch-1 migrated candidate behavior: evaluation-only in-memory component mask suppressing Batch-1 fixed locators while preserving triggers, repos, and concepts; generic D3.5 structured replacement ON; d3_5_selectivity_v2 caps 8/4; K=3 bounded reserved rerank admission; rerank pool 30.

formal_slots_32_schedule.order_principle: Strict case-major paired order: for each case, BEFORE_COMPAT followed immediately by AFTER_BATCH1_REPLACEMENT.

metric_definitions_and_applicability.combined_candidate_recall_semantics: Computed strictly as the union of channel_rankings (rankings across retrieval channels) as defined by the repository evaluator, rather than a potentially divergent proxy.
metric_definitions_and_applicability.applicability_semantics: Per repository evaluation policy, retrieval metrics apply strictly to answered cases (13 cases). Negative control questions with expected_status=insufficient_evidence (g025, g041, g007) are evaluated separately and excluded from answered denominators.
reporting_scopes: Gold subset (7 answered cases: g029, g036, g020, g060, g052, g055, g021)
novel_dev subset (6 answered cases: n021, n022, n006, n014, n003, n004)

targeted_t2_generalization_diagnostics.description: Gold minus novel_dev gaps (BEFORE and AFTER) across all analogous retrieval metrics where meaningful.

evidence_group_retention_rules.applicability_labeling: All 16 formal cases report group retention with explicit applicability and negative-control labeling (ANSWERED vs NEGATIVE_CONTROL_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) to prevent silent conversion of negative controls into ordinary answered cases.

critical_group_regressions.definition: Applicable critical evidence groups retained under BEFORE but lost under AFTER.

noncritical_group_regressions.definition: Applicable noncritical evidence groups retained under BEFORE but lost under AFTER.
noncritical_group_regressions.reporting: Reported transparently as diagnostic; contributes to aggregate final evidence recall deltas.

evidence_group_retention_rules.g021_e2_handling: Participates naturally in the 16-case cohort evaluation without any special branch, exception, or repair rule.

grounding_and_version_safety.hard_condition: All grounding/version/provenance regression counters must equal 0.

rule_specifications.WRONG_VERSION_REGRESSIONS: Counts newly introduced wrong-version evidence in AFTER relative to BEFORE (in AFTER final evidence, not in BEFORE final evidence for the same case). Does NOT count historical or persistent wrong-version evidence present in both arms.
rule_specifications.GROUNDING_REGRESSIONS: Counts newly introduced forbidden/out-of-scope grounding violations in AFTER relative to BEFORE evaluated using existing Gold selectors (q.forbidden_evidence matching).
rule_specifications.INVALID_PROVENANCE_RECOVERIES: Meaningful check for AFTER structured recoveries and target witnesses: requires governed path, non-empty provenance origins, and valid source_id; catches un-governed or origin-less bridge candidates admitted into final evidence.

grounding_and_version_safety.reporting: Evidence-level details recorded for each detected violation.

batch1_target_reproduction.requirement: Both target groups must be retained under AFTER with valid governed structured admission witness (governed provenance path, selected by v2, competed in rerank pool, retained in final evidence).
dependency_removal_conditions: Fixed locator inputs active in BEFORE
Exact masked locator inputs absent in AFTER
Generic structured mechanism active in AFTER
Valid governed witness exists in AFTER

before_reference_validity.requirement: Fresh BEFORE arm must reproduce compatibility reference baseline: g036.e1 and g021.e1 retained, with no catastrophic reference failure across safety surface.

bounded_regression_thresholds.tolerance_rule: Absolute delta (AFTER - BEFORE) on full applicable cohort (13 answered cases)

levels.description: Triggered by incomplete 32-cell execution, wrong case set, wrong mask, wrong arms, wrong model contract, post-exposure treatment/evaluator mutation, treatment attribution failure, or protected dataset violation.
Triggered when fresh BEFORE arm fails to reproduce required compatibility reference (g036.e1 or g021.e1 missing under BEFORE) and no structural protocol invalidity occurred.
Triggered when either g036.e1 or g021.e1 fails AFTER retention or valid structured witness attribution.
Triggered when CRITICAL_GROUP_REGRESSIONS > 0, GROUNDING_REGRESSIONS > 0, WRONG_VERSION_REGRESSIONS > 0, or INVALID_PROVENANCE_RECOVERIES > 0.
Triggered when targets reproduce and critical/grounding gates are clean, but one or more primary aggregate metrics violate the frozen -0.05 tolerance (or critical final evidence delta < 0).

Triggered when all 32 cells execute validly, BEFORE reference valid, both target replacements reproduced with structured witness (2/2), dependency removed (2/2), critical regressions = 0, grounding regressions = 0, and all primary metric deltas satisfy bounded tolerances.

post_exposure_mutation_accounting.tolerance: Zero tolerance: any post-exposure mutation violates Level 1 protocol validity and renders the experiment INVALID.
